pattern_kind=marker means: every call to __custom_fma(a,b,c) in the user's
C source is rewritten by tree-ssa-fma.cc into IFN_RISCV_FMA(a,b,c).
The compiler does NOT have to prove a*b+c equivalence — see examples/fma_demo.c.
